review_method: All 13 QA01 pages directly inspected. QA02 pages 1-6 have identical rendered hashes; all changed QA02 pages 7-13 directly inspected at original resolution.

page_notes.1: Title, abstract, introduction and condition equation legible.
page_notes.2: Target, geometry, gun context, materials and geometry figure legible.
page_notes.3: Population, architecture diagram and response exposition legible.
page_notes.4: Response, activity and flow equations legible.
page_notes.5: Channel placement, energy shares and decoder legible.
page_notes.6: Training, evaluation definitions and component bound legible.
page_notes.7: Evaluation, classifier caveat, main results table and energy opening legible.
page_notes.8: Anchored Figure 3, response uncertainty, empty events and depth results legible.
page_notes.9: Anchored Figure 4 including all three aggregate comparisons and classifier discussion legible.
page_notes.10: Discussion, limitations and timing legible; no one-line widow.
page_notes.11: Conclusion, availability, acknowledgments, disclosure and Appendix A table legible.
page_notes.12: Appendices and all calibration/classifier tables legible.

scope: Document consistency and visual review, not new physics validation.
